name: Habits
description: A private habit & streak tracker for Standard Notes: daily/weekday/weekly-target habits, check-off or count goals, Today / Calendar (3-week / Month / Year zoom) / Stats / Insights / Journal views, with a daily progress ring, per-habit 7-day momentum strips, tap-to-log rows, streaks, completion rates, and a local Insights view (momentum, weekly trend, best/worst days, per-habit momentum, habit co-occurrence, and journal word stats). All data is stored inside the note and protected by Standard Notes' end-to-end encryption.
